description:
Calculate and report the 20-period correlation between AAPL and MSFT based on Daily data.

NinjaTrader 8 is open at the Control Center. Historical daily data for AAPL and MSFT (Jan 2023 – Dec 2024) is available.

Expected Actions:
1. Open a Daily chart for AAPL.
2. Add MSFT as a secondary Data Series to the same chart.
3. Add the 'Correlation' indicator with Period=20 and set the Comparison Series to MSFT.
4. Identify the correlation value for the last available trading day (Dec 31, 2024).
5. Create a file at 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\NinjaTraderTasks\correlation_report.txt' containing only the numeric value (e.g., 0.85).
6. Save the workspace.
